title: JVM Internals & Performance
intro: JVM internals is the deep-Java topic where senior interviewers probe hardest. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with JVM architecture (class loading, runtime data areas, execution engine), then memory analysis (heap regions, metaspace), then garbage collection (the GC algorithms — this is where most questions land). From there it moves to the production tier — JVM tuning, profiling and debugging — and closes with comparisons and scenario-based questions.
